caption: High-fidelity mobile UI, clean e-commerce style, light color palette with subtle gray accents. Features a focus on usability and clear information hierarchy.  The layout includes a top app bar with a search field 'Find anything for your home...' and a shopping cart icon. Below is a section titled 'Bedroom Furniture' followed by a list view of furniture categories like 'Beds', 'Headboards', 'Dressers', each with a corresponding product image. A bottom navigation bar contains icons and labels for 'Home', 'Shop', 'My Boards', and 'Account'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern style, with a blue and white color palette. Uses a hero image background with a blurred effect.  The layout features a top app bar with the 'realtor.com' logo and 'LOGIN / SIGN UP' link. Below, there's a heading 'Start your search' with a segmented control for 'FOR SALE' and 'FOR RENT'. A prominent search input field with the placeholder text 'City, Zip, School, or Address in US' is present. Two buttons labeled 'Search by commute' and 'Search nearby' are arranged below, separated by an 'OR' label.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern aesthetic, with a teal and white color palette. The layout features a focus on visual content.  Search bar with the text 'Anywhere. Anytime. 1 guest' at the top. Tab navigation bar with 'FOR YOU', 'HOMES', 'EXPERIENCES', and 'PLACES' options. Two-column grid of card components displaying images of experiences. Each card includes a price, duration, and description, such as '$28 1 hour · wine & wine tasting' and '$51 2 hours · art & painting'. 'FILTERS' button. Bottom navigation bar with icons and labels: 'EXPLORE', 'SAVED', 'TRIPS', 'INBOX', and 'PROFILE'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, onboarding flow, flat illustration style. Soft, pastel color palette with a focus on teal and muted grays. Clean, modern aesthetic.  Full-screen layout featuring a hero illustration of a person relaxing with a phone. Below the illustration is a headline 'Stress-free planning' and supporting copy. Primary CTA button 'GET STARTED' with a solid fill. Page indicator dots at the bottom.

High-fidelity mobile UI, playful and bright theme, with a dark purple background and vibrant circular icons. Uses a clean, modern sans-serif typeface.  Screen displays a 'Health Log' form with multiple choice selections. Includes a top app bar with a close icon and 'NEXT' button. Sections include questions like 'Why are you feeling this way?' with options for 'Love Life', 'Friends', 'Family', 'School', 'Work'. Next section asks 'Experiencing any symptoms?' with options 'Cramps', 'Tender Breasts', 'Acne', 'Headache', 'Bloating'. Further sections ask 'Did you exercise?' with options 'Cardio', 'Yoga/Pilates', 'Toning', 'Other', and 'Did you indulge?' with options 'Sweets', 'Salty Snacks', 'Alcohol'. Selected options have a green checkmark.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern style, light color palette with teal accents. Features a travel-themed hero image and a tabbed navigation bar.  The screen displays 'Offers' with a hero image showcasing 'IRCTC WEBSITE' and a promotional message 'Up to ₹ 100 cashback on IRCTC Website!'. Below, a segmented control with tabs 'POPULAR OFFERS', 'NEARBY STORES', and 'RESTAURANTS'. A list view displays cards for 'Nearby Stores' and 'Restaurants' with titles, logos, and text like 'Get 20% cashback on WH Smith stores!' and 'Freebies @ Wow Momo!'. Each section has a 'More' button. A circular FAB is positioned at the bottom right.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and minimalist style, with a light red and gray color palette. The interface features a modern, user-friendly design.  App bar with title 'Stocard' and settings icon. Tab bar with 'MY CARDS' (selected) and 'OFFERS' (with badge '14'). Main content area displays two card previews with placeholder logos and the text '01234567890' and 'Carlo Stocard'. Below, a section with the title 'Add your cards here' and subtitle 'Adding your first card only takes seconds!'. Primary CTA 'ADD CARD' and a red FAB with a '+' icon at the bottom right.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern style, bright primary color palette. Features a gradient blue background and ample whitespace.  The screen displays a 'Sign Up' form with input fields for 'Name', 'Email', 'Password', and 'Confirm Password', each with a light blue icon. A checkbox precedes the text "I have read and accepted the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy". A primary CTA button 'SUBMIT' is at the bottom. The app logo 'EasyBox' is centered at the top.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern aesthetic, with a teal and white color palette. The design emphasizes usability and visual clarity.  The layout features a top search bar with the placeholder text 'Anywhere. Anytime. 1 guest'. Below is a tab bar with options like 'FOR YOU', 'HOMES', 'EXPERIENCES', and 'PLACES'. A card component displays a hero image of a property, followed by details like '$81 Private room in London' and a star rating with '156 Reviews'. Another card with a landscape hero image is present, with inline buttons 'MAP' and 'FILTERS'. A bottom navigation bar includes icons for 'EXPLORE', 'SAVED', 'TRIPS', 'INBOX', and 'PROFILE'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, corporate theme, primary blue color palette with white and gold accents. Clean and simple design with a focus on usability.  Login screen featuring a background image of a truck. UI elements include: 'Username' and 'Password' input fields, a 'Remember Me' checkbox, 'LOGIN HELP' link, and a primary CTA button labeled 'LOG IN'. Bottom text link 'ACCOUNT RECOVERY / NEW ACCOUNT'. App version number at the very bottom.

Top app bar with back arrow and 'Add new interests' title on the left, and 'DONE' button on the right. Centered header text reads 'YOU'RE ALMOST DONE!' with supporting body copy below.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean e-commerce theme, neutral color palette with ample whitespace. Modern and minimalist aesthetic. High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern design, with a bright and airy aesthetic. The color palette features a primary teal, with accents of soft lavender and muted green on a white background. A primary CTA button 'Start Your Search' is centrally aligned. The bottom nav bar contains icons for 'Feed', 'Search', 'Saves', 'Alerts', and 'More'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, travel app, clean style, and a cool color palette. Uses a standard list layout with image cards and clear typography.  The app features a top navigation bar with location details and date input. Below are tabbed controls for 'Sort', 'Filter', and 'Map'. The main content area displays hotel listings in a card format, each with a hero image, hotel name (e.g., 'Sofitel London Heathrow'), location details, price (e.g., '$202.52'), and a rating indicator with text 'Excellent'. The list view continues with similar hotel card components.

High-fidelity mobile UI, vibrant and modern theme, with a bright color palette and clean typography. The layout features a grid-based design with a focus on visual content. Below, a 'Featured' label precedes a two-column grid of card components, each with a hero image, title (e.g., 'in a crystal Ball'), subtitle, avatar, and 'Follow' button. High-fidelity mobile UI, clean e-commerce theme, pastel color palette with a focus on light blues and purples. Modern, with ample whitespace and clear typography. Below are two product cards with lifestyle hero images, the first showcasing rain boots and umbrellas, and the second featuring hats, gloves, and scarves. Each card has a title and a short description: 'Get rain ready!' and 'Discounts against cold weather!'. A bottom navigation bar contains icons for home, search, cart, and profile. High-fidelity mobile UI, calming and serene theme, with a pastel pink and blue color palette. Clean and modern aesthetic.  The screen features the 'agoda' logo at the top left with a multi-colored dot cluster. High-fidelity mobile UI, e-commerce fashion app, pastel and neutral color palette. Clean, modern aesthetic with a focus on visual merchandising and brand consistency.
